newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle thin $103/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle thin $103/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle traded at $102.50 to $103.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in light activity near midday Wednesday, market sources said.

The sales were steady with the bulk of active sales on Tuesday, although there were a few at $104.00 on that day, they said. About 1,000 head traded near midday, which brought weekly movement near 59,000, the sources said.

Buyer inquiry was light following the active sales on Tuesday and hefty trading last week. Packers reportedly were well stocked with live inventory, with some not yet taking delivery of cattle sold last week, the sources said.
